evidence.summary: Setup-hook timing risk investigated and cleared. vitest setupFiles beforeAll hooks run AFTER test-file module evaluation, so any test constructing the report service at module scope would miss RUNTIME_ARTIFACTS_ROOT and continue racing on the shared directory. Grepped all 16 test files referencing buildApp/createReportService: zero module-scope construction, every call sits inside a hook or helper function. The env var is therefore always set before any service is built.

Production path confirmed byte-identical. With neither deps.artifactRoot nor RUNTIME_ARTIFACTS_ROOT set, path.resolve(path.join(process.cwd(), '.runtime-artifacts')) is equivalent to the original path.resolve(process.cwd(), '.runtime-artifacts'). app.ts passes neither, so runtime behavior is unchanged.

findings: AUDITOR ACTION REQUIRED: the ticket required a build-level `decision` recording TASK-012's scope extension to cover the .runtime-artifacts flake. Because the engineer's write_scope is tasks[id=TASK-012], that decision could only be staged as tasks[TASK-012].proposed_decisions[3], not written into the top-level decisions array. Promoting it to DEC-005 at sign-off requires auditor authority and is not something this orchestrator may do.

.gitignore uses root-anchored /*.tar, /*.tar.gz and /*.zip rather than the specific inventoried filenames. Broader than the literal audit wording but root-anchored and judged defensible: no legitimate root-level archive exists in this monorepo and the entry's purpose is to stop the category silently reappearing untracked.
